name: devtool 0.2.32 simplified single-run frontend
description: Complete devtool source repository with one run per repository, a single-run Android app bridge, native app Tasker integration, optional root bridge, and no legacy Termux notification, Tasker CLI, or concurrency flags.
highlights: One non-waiting run lock per repository
One active Android notification and floating HUD card
Legacy android-notify and Termux notification fallback removed
Legacy Tasker CLI flags and broadcast path removed
Optional non-Zygisk KernelSU/Magisk root bridge retained
Dotnet build uses --no-restore and test uses --no-build during validation
